title: Discovery of Antioxidant Peptide Against Keap1 From Silkworm Protein Based on In Silico Study and In Vitro Antioxidant Activity Detection.
authors: Ye, Shuoliang; Qi, Mengyue; Wang, Jianhua; Zhang, Qiuyi; Fang, Lan; Huo, Yan; Li, Zhiyong
journal: Journal of peptide science : an official publication of the European Peptide Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟消化、ADMET预测和分子对接从蚕蛹蛋白中筛选抗氧化肽WQK，研究其与Keap1蛋白的结合，属于蛋白-小肽互作而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以分子对接为主，与课题核心的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Nrf2-Keap1 is an important defense system against oxidative stress damage and enhances the body's antioxidant capacity. Targeting the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway and activating Nrf2 has become an effective strategy for treating oxidative stress and related diseases. In this study, virtual digestion, ADMET prediction, and molecular docking were used to screen antioxidant peptide from silkworm pupa protein. Then, a novel tripeptide (WQK) was identified, exhibiting good water solubility, nontoxicity, high intestinal absorption, and the ability to cross the blood-brain barrier. Molecular docking showed that WQK established six H-bond interactions with some key sites of Keap1 (Arg380, Arg415, Gln530, Ser555, Ile416, and Leu365), which is similar to the identified antioxidant molecule 12e. Additionally, WQK has the function to reduce ABTS.(+) and ferric-tripyridyltriazine (Fe(3+)-TPTZ) in vitro. Furthermore, WQK can promote the expression of antioxidant genes and eliminate reactive oxygen species (ROS) in oxalic acid-treated human proximal tubular epithelial cells (HK-2). The results suggested that WQK may activate the Keap1-Nrf2 signaling pathway by binding to Keap1 and activating the antioxidant system.
abstract_zh: Nrf2-Keap1是抵抗氧化应激损伤的重要防御系统，能增强机体抗氧化能力。靶向Keap1-Nrf2信号通路并激活Nrf2已成为治疗氧化应激及相关疾病的有效策略。本研究采用虚拟消化、ADMET预测和分子对接技术，从蚕蛹蛋白中筛选抗氧化肽。随后，鉴定出一种新型三肽（WQK），其具有良好的水溶性、无毒性、高肠道吸收性及穿越血脑屏障的能力。分子对接显示，WQK与Keap1的多个关键位点（Arg380、Arg415、Gln530、Ser555、Ile416和Leu365）建立了六个氢键相互作用，这与已鉴定的抗氧化分子12e相似。此外，WQK在体外具有还原ABTS.(+)和三价铁-三吡啶三嗪（Fe(3+)-TPTZ）的功能。进一步研究表明，WQK能促进草酸处理的人近端肾小管上皮细胞（HK-2）中抗氧化基因的表达，并清除活性氧（ROS）。结果表明，WQK可能通过结合Keap1并激活抗氧化系统，从而激活Keap1-Nrf2信号通路。
